title: Oven Roasted Thai Shrimp Nam Prik
description: A charred and crisp weeknight Thai dish featuring shrimp and nam prik sauce, ready in under 30 minutes. This southern-Thai inspired recipe is perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together nam prik sauce, fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, and salt.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the shrimp in a single layer.
Drizzle the vegetable oil over the shrimp and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Roast the shrimp in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes, or until pink and cooked through.
Remove the shrimp from the oven and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
